mechanism.claim: Binance BTCUSD COIN-M and BTCUSDT USD-M perpetuals express leverage demand against different collateral. During volatile BTC trading, a sharp completed increase in COIN-M funding relative to USD-M funding indicates increasingly crowded BTC-collateral leverage and is faded short; a sharp relative decrease indicates inverse-side deleveraging and is faded long.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the one-settlement change in COIN-M minus USD-M funding
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior cross-collateral candidates used OI, liquidation snapshots, order-book geometry, or dated-futures curves. HVILFT uses only the realized funding-transfer difference between the two perpetual collateral systems and reuses no event set or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: funding-transfer onsets enter at settlement+10m on an endogenous sparse subset; Gross9 has no inverse-versus-linear funding differential primitive

source_contract.row_validity: exact integer millisecond calc_time on a five-minute boundary; finite funding rate; integer funding_interval_hours exactly 8; unique timestamp per instrument
source_contract.pair_validity: exact one-to-one calc_time match for BTCUSD_PERP and BTCUSDT; no nearest join, interpolation, forward fill, or partial pair
source_contract.causal_availability: funding is economically realized at calc_time; decision is conservatively fixed at calc_time+5m and entry at calc_time+10m
source_contract.transport: checksum-verified monthly Binance Vision ZIPs through the latest complete month; official REST funding history only for the unarchived final tail; every response and normalized panel hash-bound
source_contract.revision_boundary: archives and REST payloads freeze this replay vintage; Binance does not expose a historical first-seen revision archive
source_contract.bounded_probe_disclosure: before preregistration, HTTP metadata for four months and only the two January 2023 CSV header lines were opened to confirm coverage and identical schema; no funding value, incidence, BTC outcome, or Gross9 row was read

feature_contract.funding_transfer: current funding_differential minus the immediately previous exact paired eight-hour settlement differential; strict nonzero
feature_contract.absolute_transfer_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(funding_transfer), current excluded, at most 1,095 valid paired settlements and minimum 540
feature_contract.btc_variation: sum squared close-to-close log returns from the exact 1,440 completed BTCUSDT bars_binance 1m rows ending at calc_time
feature_contract.eligible_state: absolute_transfer_rank>=0.80, btc_variation_rank>=0.65, and funding_transfer strict nonzero
feature_contract.onset: current paired settlement eligible and immediately previous paired settlement ineligible

oos_clock.reservation: chronological first eligible onset while flat; intervals half-open and exit first on an equal-time entry
oos_clock.funding: signal inputs are paired realized rates; PnL funding opened only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, favorable-then-adverse held 5m path, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged passes every sequential economic stage

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent realized funding-transfer mechanism fixed before funding values, candidate incidence, or outcomes

stopping_rule: freeze preregistration, source support, Gross9 novelty, and sequential economics; terminal first failure with no instrument, pairing, history, rank, volatility gate, onset, side, delay, hold, subset, or control repair
